items.subject: AP Physics 1
items.finding: Part (a) combines the original 50 N result, the prediction that tension doubles, and the new 100 N result in one point.
items.repair_contract: Represent the original result, prediction, doubled-weight result, and torque-equilibrium explanation as independently assessable requirements.
items.point_budget_decision: Qualified author must confirm. Four atomic one-point criteria is the clearest candidate; document any lower total and its partial-credit rule.

items.subject: AP Physics 1
items.finding: The plotted-relationship criterion also accepts a constant ratio, which is not a plot.
items.repair_contract: Keep the constant-ratio test in part (a). Require a graph such as ln(E_n) versus cycle number with a linear trend for part (b).
items.point_budget_decision: Keep the existing three-point total unless the qualified author identifies another prompt change.
checks: constant-ratio language remains only in part (a)

items.subject: AP Physics 2
items.finding: One criterion combines an assumption and an uncertainty-reduction method.
items.repair_contract: Assess the calorimetry assumption separately from the uncertainty-reduction method; distinguish repeated trials from heat-loss mitigation.
items.point_budget_decision: Qualified author must confirm whether total points increase from 3 to 4 or whether another existing task is regrouped.
checks: random uncertainty distinguished from heat loss

items.subject: AP Physics 2
items.finding: The prompt asks for two controls but the rubric awards the point for one.
items.repair_contract: Require two distinct valid controls, including material and temperature or equivalent valid controls.
items.point_budget_decision: The existing three-point total may remain if the control criterion explicitly requires both controls.

items.subject: AP Physics 2
items.finding: Real/virtual, orientation, and relative size are combined into one all-or-nothing point.
items.repair_contract: Provide independent credit for real, inverted, and enlarged without double-crediting the ray construction.
items.point_budget_decision: Qualified author must choose a schema-compatible integer-point structure; a five-point total is the fully atomic candidate.

items.subject: AP Physics C: Electricity and Magnetism
items.finding: Surface electric field and surface charge density comparisons are combined.
items.repair_contract: Separate the field comparison from the surface-charge-density comparison.
items.point_budget_decision: Four one-point criteria is the clearest candidate; qualified author must confirm the new total.

items.subject: AP Physics C: Mechanics
items.finding: Angular speed and period are combined into one result criterion.
items.repair_contract: Assess the angular-speed derivation and period conversion independently.
items.point_budget_decision: Four one-point criteria is the clearest candidate; qualified author must confirm the new total.

items.subject: AP Physics C: Mechanics
items.finding: Translational acceleration and pulley angular acceleration are combined.
items.repair_contract: Assess the mass acceleration and the no-slip angular-acceleration result independently.
items.point_budget_decision: Seven one-point criteria is the fully atomic candidate; qualified author must confirm.

items.subject: AP Physics 2
items.finding: The sources are coherent but not explicitly in phase, and part (b) states incorrect wavelength counts.
items.repair_contract: State that the sources are initially in phase. Correct the initial ratio to 2.5 wavelengths and the doubled ratio to 5 wavelengths.
items.point_budget_decision: Keep two points unless independent review finds the explanation task needs separation.

items.subject: AP Physics 2
items.finding: Part (b) incorrectly says the charges are kept at the midpoint and omits requested numerical potential support.
items.repair_contract: Refer to evaluating the field and potential at the new midpoint. Add correct initial and doubled-separation potential values to the canonical answer and rubric.
items.point_budget_decision: Keep two points if both numerical potential and field reasoning fit the existing part (a) criterion.

items.subject: AP Physics C: Electricity and Magnetism
items.finding: The +x direction conclusion assumes V0>0 and L>0.
items.repair_contract: Define L as a positive length scale and V0>0 in the stimulus; make part (b) assess the absence of y and z field components.
items.point_budget_decision: Keep two points.

items.subject: AP Physics C: Electricity and Magnetism
items.finding: The current sign is undefined; derivation, charge, and current are also combined.
items.repair_contract: Define positive current as flowing onto the initially positive plate, or choose another explicit convention and update all signs consistently. Separate derivation, q(t), and i(t).
items.point_budget_decision: This mixed repair likely requires a new point total; qualified author must justify the chosen structure.

items.subject: AP Physics C: Mechanics
items.finding: The stimulus does not label the masses although the rubric uses m1 and m2.
items.repair_contract: Label the first mass m1 and the second mass m2 in the student-visible stimulus; preserve the existing physics and rubric.
items.point_budget_decision: Keep three points.

items.subject: AP Physics C: Mechanics
items.finding: The initial condition v(0)=v0 is unstated and two distractor rationales are inaccurate.
items.repair_contract: State v(0)=v0. Revise A to describe linear growth rather than decay and D as an inverse-time expression that does not satisfy the ODE.
items.point_budget_decision: Not applicable.

items.subject: AP Biology
items.finding: A required mosaic plot is atypical for an AP Biology short FRQ and the artifact contains inconsistent table representations.
items.repair_contract: Choose an AP-aligned representation. Prefer a segmented or side-by-side bar chart, or make mosaic plotting an explicitly supported alternative with a sample-size-width hint. Reconcile stimulus, prompt_json stimulus, table, expected graph specification, and criteria to one data set.
items.point_budget_decision: Qualified Biology author must confirm the representation and four-point budget.
checks: sample-size encoding explicit if mosaic remains

items.subject: AP Biology
items.finding: The combinatorial DSCAM detail is above the intended AP Biology level.
items.repair_contract: Preserve the construct that alternative splicing lets one gene produce multiple protein isoforms. Simplify the exon counts and wording, then rebuild all choices and rationales at AP level.
items.point_budget_decision: Not applicable.

items.subject: AP Chemistry
items.finding: The tutor says the item should ask for heat capacity, but the existing calculation and units correctly target specific heat capacity.
items.repair_contract: A qualified Chemistry adjudicator must first determine whether the reviewer finding is wrong. Do not change to heat capacity unless the stem, calculation, units, answer, and distractors are intentionally redesigned together.
items.point_budget_decision: Not applicable.

items.subject: AP Physics 1
items.finding: The experimental-design rubric names variables but does not require a measurement procedure or comparison to the predicted relationship.
items.repair_contract: Require an instrument, measurements at multiple times, and comparison with a predicted v-versus-t or displacement-versus-t relation. Align controls with the tested model.
items.point_budget_decision: Qualified author must determine whether the procedure and model comparison need separate points.

items.subject: AP Physics 2
items.finding: Measuring only the combined field or potential does not test superposition, and the rubric treats vector field and scalar potential interchangeably.
items.repair_contract: Choose either electric field or potential. Require separate measurements for each charge and both charges, then compare the combined measurement with the appropriate vector or scalar sum.
items.point_budget_decision: Qualified author must determine whether procedure, variables, and comparison require additional points.

items.subject: AP Physics C: Electricity and Magnetism
items.finding: The prompt refers to B(r), while the rubric varies current at fixed radius.
items.repair_contract: Choose and state one relationship: B versus r at fixed I, or B versus I at fixed r. Require a field probe procedure, prediction comparison, and controls for geometry, probe orientation, and end effects.
items.point_budget_decision: Qualified author must set the point budget after choosing the tested relationship.

items.subject: AP Statistics
items.finding: The tutor requested wording that is already exactly present in the current stem.
items.repair_contract: Do not create a no-op rewrite. A qualified Statistics reviewer should confirm that the current wording and slope criterion are aligned, then record a no-change disposition.
items.point_budget_decision: Keep one point.
checks: slope 3 interpreted per one-unit x increase
